context_requirements: Functional thyroid peroxidase (TPO) expression, essentially restricted to thyroid follicular cells
Thyroid hormone synthesis pathway activity, absent in the nine non-thyroid lines
Iodide organification capacity, not present in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is not explained by vehicle or general toxicity
Evidence of DIO1-mediated thyroid hormone metabolism changes in these lines
